docker-doctor ships 25 rules across 5 categories. Every diagnostic carries a full rule key (e.g. `docker-doctor/no-root-user`) that you can pass to `rules explain` or use to tune severity in your config. Each rule below links to a page with failing and fixed examples.

List everything docker-doctor knows about:

```bash
npx @docker-doctor/cli@latest rules list
```

Explain any single rule in depth:

```bash
npx @docker-doctor/cli@latest rules explain <rule>
```

## Security

Catches Dockerfile patterns that widen your attack surface.

- [`no-root-user`](/docs/reference/rules/no-root-user) — Container should not run as root user (`warning`)
- [`no-secrets-in-env`](/docs/reference/rules/no-secrets-in-env) — Do not store secrets in ENV or ARG instructions (`error`)
- [`pin-image-version`](/docs/reference/rules/pin-image-version) — Always pin base image versions to specific tags (`warning`)
- [`no-add-remote`](/docs/reference/rules/no-add-remote) — Avoid using ADD with remote URLs (`warning`)

## Performance

Reduces build time and layer bloat.

- [`use-multi-stage`](/docs/reference/rules/use-multi-stage) — Consider using multi-stage builds (`info`)
- [`order-layers`](/docs/reference/rules/order-layers) — Order layers to maximize build cache utility (`warning`)
- [`minimize-layers`](/docs/reference/rules/minimize-layers) — Minimize the number of image layers (`info`)
- [`use-dockerignore`](/docs/reference/rules/use-dockerignore) — Ensure .dockerignore is used (`warning`)

## Best Practices

General Dockerfile and Compose hygiene.

- [`require-healthcheck`](/docs/reference/rules/require-healthcheck) — Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction (`info`)
- [`prefer-copy-over-add`](/docs/reference/rules/prefer-copy-over-add) — Prefer COPY over ADD (`warning`)
- [`use-exec-form`](/docs/reference/rules/use-exec-form) — Use exec form for CMD and ENTRYPOINT (`warning`)
- [`require-labels`](/docs/reference/rules/require-labels) — Add LABEL metadata to images (`info`)
- [`combine-apt-update-install`](/docs/reference/rules/combine-apt-update-install) — Combine apt-get update and apt-get install (`warning`)
- [`use-pipefail`](/docs/reference/rules/use-pipefail) — Use pipefail to catch pipeline command failures (`warning`)
- [`absolute-workdir`](/docs/reference/rules/absolute-workdir) — Use absolute paths for WORKDIR (`warning`)
- [`avoid-run-cd`](/docs/reference/rules/avoid-run-cd) — Avoid changing directories with cd in RUN (`info`)
- [`sort-multiline-args`](/docs/reference/rules/sort-multiline-args) — Sort multi-line arguments alphanumerically (`info`)
- [`useradd-no-log-init`](/docs/reference/rules/useradd-no-log-init) — Use --no-log-init with useradd (`warning`)

## Compose

Docker Compose-specific checks.

- [`no-version-key`](/docs/reference/rules/no-version-key) — Remove the 'version' key from Compose file (`warning`)
- [`require-resource-limits`](/docs/reference/rules/require-resource-limits) — Define resource limits for services (`warning`)
- [`require-restart-policy`](/docs/reference/rules/require-restart-policy) — Set restart policy for services (`warning`)
- [`use-depends-on-condition`](/docs/reference/rules/use-depends-on-condition) — Use long-form depends_on with healthcheck conditions (`info`)

## Image Size

Keeps final images small.

- [`prefer-slim-base`](/docs/reference/rules/prefer-slim-base) — Use slim, alpine, or distroless base images (`info`)
- [`clean-package-cache`](/docs/reference/rules/clean-package-cache) — Clean up package manager cache in the same RUN layer (`warning`)
- [`avoid-dev-dependencies`](/docs/reference/rules/avoid-dev-dependencies) — Avoid installing development dependencies in final production stage (`warning`)

See [Configuration](/docs/reference/configuration) to change a rule's severity or turn off a whole category.
